body: Treat this checkout as one multi-product Harmony application. The root build profile composes common, feature, and phone/PC/TV/wearable product modules. Inventory every tracked source before narrowing; do not infer whole-repository semantic coverage from the existing selected-path case Skills.
title: Code Workshop repository boundary

body: Use exact AST facts and cross-file import/call evidence to trace responsibilities from product shells through feature modules into common services. Preserve unresolved dispatch and runtime behavior as explicit gaps; syntax success is not a behavior proof.
title: Code Workshop responsibility analysis

body: Mine candidates only after binding an owning module, cross-file responsibility chain, editable/context paths, and an independent oracle. Existing debounce, feedback, image, loading, cache, and ArkWeb families are calibration evidence, not permission to skip unexplored modules. Shared imports alone are never cases.
title: Code Workshop seed policy

body: Treat guide-snippets as a corpus of independently buildable sample projects, not one application. Establish the owning sample root from its nearest root build-profile before interpreting module facts. Repository-wide counts measure corpus coverage; build and test claims must be per sample root.
title: Guide Snippets corpus boundary

body: Partition facts by sample root before building call, state, lifecycle, or native bridge graphs. The repository mixes ArkTS, TypeScript, C++, resources, and generated/editor artifacts. Report parser exclusions and unresolved references per project so one noisy sample cannot contaminate another.
title: Guide Snippets project-partitioned analysis

body: Use this corpus for breadth, project-boundary discovery, and false-positive suppression. A candidate must stay inside one declared sample unless a source-to-source cross-sample dependency is proven. High-cardinality SDK imports such as ArkUI or hypium are routing signals, not difficulty evidence by themselves.
title: Guide Snippets seed and noise policy

body: Treat the exact 44-file checkout as one Harmony entry application. The application has nine ArkTS files and four product-type pages; the tracked source contains no test suite. Keep later injected ohosTest assets separate from upstream repository knowledge.
title: Harmony IAP client boundary

body: The consumable path is query environment, recover unfinished purchases, decode purchase data, verify/deliver through an application-server seam, then finish the purchase. Exact local dataflow to iap.finishPurchase is supported; external SDK signature, server verification, account state, and callback scheduling remain runtime contracts.
title: Harmony IAP purchase lifecycle

body: Do not keep mining only purchaseData. Sample independent boundaries across environment readiness, product query, consumable recovery/finish, non-consumable ownership, subscription lifecycle, navigation, and JWS parsing. Every promoted case requires upstream-aligned ohosTest or device observables plus wrong-variant discrimination.
title: Harmony IAP diversified seed policy

body: Treat this revision as a 24-plugin monorepo and scope IAP knowledge to the 104-file cordova-plugin-hms-iap subtree. The IAP package contains TypeScript/compiled JavaScript, Cordova metadata and hooks, an Android Java bridge, type declarations, and Cordova/Ionic examples.
title: Cordova HMS IAP subtree boundary

body: Trace each operation across TypeScript asyncExec, plugin.xml service/action registration, Java Cordova dispatch, HMS SDK Task completion, mapper output, and example consumption. The purchaseData example flow is exact only through a bounded local chain; object identity, external HMS behavior, reachability, exception flow, and callback ordering remain unresolved.
title: Cordova HMS IAP bridge analysis

body: Mine across structurally distinct bridge concerns: action routing, request mapping, Task success/failure conversion, activity-result handling, hooks/plugin installation, declarations versus runtime exports, and example integration. Require a repaired build/test contract before promotion because the package build script currently invokes tsc without inputs or a root tsconfig.
title: Cordova HMS IAP diversified seed policy
